description: Same-job A/A paired runs of the budgets baseline commit 3144bb32c6ebf8f1eefa2cbbad7d431d1d6e8c4c on the GitHub-hosted Linux runner: the baseline built twice in one job and measured against itself. The largest ratio deviation per row sets the timing thresholds (#303).
limitations: Each run built both sides from source in one job and measured them in six counterbalanced rounds (A B B A ...) of one core assessment invocation with two fresh-process samples each, so twelve samples per side per row.
Only the reduced samples are kept here; each run's raw invocation outputs are in its uploaded artifact (digest recorded).
Six runs on four CPU models (AMD EPYC 7763, 9V74, 9V45, Intel Xeon Platinum 8573C); a machine class not seen here could be noisier.
The per-row maximum of six runs is a small-sample bound; thresholds double it and apply the policy floors.
